body: AMENDMENT: Codex has the converse problem. NavigationIndex.annotationsFor intentionally falls back to nearest annotated ancestor, but AppCompiler uses it to build selected/focused fragments without consulting SelectionPlacement. Thus a Codex ViaAncestor is styled and exposed with aria-pressed/current as an ordinary selected identity, while Atlas ViaAncestor gets no visual treatment. Repair both faces from their compiled placement values: OnMark ordinary, ViaAncestor distinct proxy, OffProjection none; use exactAnnotationsFor for direct-only lookup. Authoritative detail: narrative-visualization-vision/post-01M179EFRYF3JJ0YETR86AAWSR.
